observed_contract.ScrollPanel: forwardRef; scrollDirection, className, style and remaining attributes are passed to a native focusable panel; ref resolves to its element
observed_contract.ScrollPanelGroup: a scrollable focus group, not a context-only provider; not used around the popup
observed_contract.controller_scroll: GAMEPAD_ANALOG_SCROLL is a mapped input action, not raw sRightStickY; its registration signature differs from old raw controller-state packets

limits: Static contract inspection only. No native Steam/Decky or physical controller execution.
